gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-anuphan: Anuphan reads with big, round bowls and curves that leave clear gaps, friendly and uncluttered, while Metamorphous above it thickens and thins in gentle steps. Body text can sit fairly small.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-arimo: Metamorphous carries a commanding, high-waisted look, with generous sidebearings and strokes that shift softly without ever turning stark. Arimo, a plain sans with a tall mean line, simply stays out of its way.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-armata: Armata is a sans-serif with generous gaps between characters. If Metamorphous were shrunk down, its soft thick-to-thin shifts and wide sidebearings would fade, whereas a large Armata would lose its compact, tidy lowercase.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-athiti: Stately meets sign-shop simple. Metamorphous does its best work as a showpiece, with its high midline and gentle stroke shifts, while Athiti, a sans cut at one line width, handles everyday text.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-atkinson-hyperleg: Metamorphous has a commanding, distinctive voice, with a g whose links thin lightly beneath sturdy bowls. And Atkinson Hyperlegible, a sans with wide-set terminals on its s, is built to be read rather than admired.

Metamorphous brings commanding presence, with large sidebearings and moderate thick and thin strokes in its display letters. And Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono, a sans with stretched-open spacing, lets that heading stand apart.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-biryani: Biryani draws every stroke like cut ribbon, with a large, clear eye on each e and no modulation anywhere. And Metamorphous above it, with its softer stems and hairlines, makes that plain sans feel unclogged and easy to settle into.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-blinker: That high-set midline gives Metamorphous its distinctive, commanding look, softened by a mellow shift between fat and slim strokes. Blinker, a sans-serif of steel-rod lines and open apertures, is what makes the pair so readable.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-carrois-gothic: Rounded letters that thicken slightly at the sides give Metamorphous its commanding character, and it excels at announcing things. And Carrois Gothic, a sans-serif with a tall x-height, excels at carrying them forward.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-carrois-gothic-sc: Grand and gently modulated, Metamorphous gives its lowercase a with softly varied stroke weights, set against Carrois Gothic SC, a sans with clear openings at each curve. One announces, and the other quietly follows.
